page.overview:
Who is Aiden?

Aiden is a character in Cars 3. He is the one of Rust-eze Racing Center trainees, the others being Kurt, Ronald and Gabriel. He has the number 3 printed on his body. pt-br:Aiden Category:Cars 3 Characters
